objective: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

description: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us.  But mooncloth is sacred.
Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
completion: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, <name>. Now I will train you.
